name: uspto-patent-research
description: Read-only USPTO patent application research, prosecution-history review, and evidence-grounded patent workflow guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Research public USPTO application records safely
interface.longDescription: Search and inspect public USPTO Patent File Wrapper records through a read-only local MCP server, then use the bundled research workflow to organize prior art, prosecution history, claim-element mappings, and patent disclosures without making legal conclusions.
defaultPrompt: Search USPTO records for prior art related to this invention.
Review the prosecution history for this application.
Build a claim-element matrix from these references.
